newsitem.title: USA: Russia to issue $1.5 billion in Eurobonds - Davydov.
newsitem.headline: Russia to issue $1.5 billion in Eurobonds - Davydov.

text.p: Russia plans to issue $1.5 billion worth of Eurobonds in 1997, said Oleg Davydov, Russia's Deputy Chairman of the government and Minister of Foreign Economic Relations.
"The choice is obvious," he told a banking conference here organized by Arthur Andersen Consulting.
He explained the interest cost for Euro borrowing is 9.35 percent, while the cost is 16 to 17 percent to raise funds in Russia.
Russia launched its first global bond of $1.0 billion in 1996, and it is widely expected that the second global issue would be in marks.
